annotations.title: Rewrite a free-form address to the new units

description: Parse a free-form Vietnamese address line (street, commune, district, province; with or without diacritics, commas or abbreviations) and rewrite it with the post-reform units: drops the district and replaces the old commune and province. Returns status (converted, already_new, province_level when only a province was given, ambiguous, partial when the commune is missing, e.g. a district alone, not_found), confidence, the rewritten address, all candidates when ambiguous, which parts were recognised and which were not. Never invents a unit. Examples: {"address":"12 Nguyễn Huệ, P. Bến Nghé, Q.1, TP.HCM"}; {"address":"so 1 phu cuong thu dau mot binh duong"}.

address.description: Free-form Vietnamese address, with or without diacritics, e.g. "12 Nguyễn Huệ, P. Bến Nghé, Q.1, TP.HCM" or "so 1 phu cuong thu dau mot binh duong".
